summary: The requirement document describes one system for four CBSE schools in Indore run by a trust, replacing registers and a desktop fees program. Parents apply for admission, pay fees and follow their child's attendance, homework and report cards on a website and a phone app, while teachers and the office manage attendance, marks, homework and timetables. The vendor also supports the system for three years after go-live.
